product_overview: VoxAgent is a multi-tenant B2B SaaS platform for agencies and enterprises to create, manage, and sell AI-powered voice assistants and outbound calling campaigns under their own brand. The platform also supports real-time transcript logging and a live calls dashboard experience for monitoring active conversations.
core_goals: Enable agencies to operate isolated multi-tenant workspaces for sub-clients
Support outbound calling campaigns at scale using AI voice infrastructure
Capture and persist real-time call transcripts for analytics and reporting
Provide a live calls navigation entry point for monitoring ongoing calls
Maintain secure webhook processing and tenant-isolated data handling

features.name: Real-time Transcript Logging
features.description: Receives Vapi webhook events for a specific agency and stores real-time transcript messages in the call_events table for later analysis and reporting.
user_flows: POST /api/webhooks/vapi/[agencyId] with a valid transcript event payload -> Receive 200 { ok: true } -> Transcript event is persisted to the call_events database table

POST /api/webhooks/vapi/[agencyId] with a malformed payload or server-side database failure -> Receive 500 { error: 'Internal error' } -> Transcript event is not persisted to the call_events database table

features.name: Live Calls Dashboard Navigation
features.description: Provides a sidebar navigation link to the Live Calls dashboard, including a LIVE badge to help users quickly access active call monitoring.
user_flows: Open the dashboard sidebar -> Click the Live Calls navigation link -> Navigate to the Live Calls dashboard page with the LIVE badge visible
Open the dashboard sidebar when the navigation item is unavailable or the dashboard route cannot be resolved -> The Live Calls destination is not reached and the dashboard remains on the current view

features.name: Real-time Transcript Logging
features.description: Logs real-time transcripts from VAPI webhooks into the call_events database table.

endpoints.description: Receives events from VAPI for a specific agency and logs transcripts
